description: Search every deal online now on Crno Jaje (crnojaje.hr, Croatia): vouchers for hotel stays and trips, wellness and spa, toplice (thermal spas), skiing, beauty treatments, health check-ups, restaurants, activities, courses, driving schools and products. All filters are optional and combine. Put Croatian words for the service in query ("wellness", "masaža", "skijanje", "jacuzzi", "romantični vikend", "zubar"); word forms are matched. Place, price, nights, persons, board and dates have their own fields; get exact category and place names from list_categories and list_places. Each result has the deal page url (where the customer buys), the price from, the regular price, the discount, the EXTRA discounts active now and the voucher's validity; get_deal gives every option and the conditions. Order: the site's own (best first), or with query the best match first.

abroad.description: true: only deals abroad; false: only deals in Croatia.

adults.description: Stays: an option for at least this many adults.

board.description: The lowest board accepted: breakfast also takes half board and more.

category.description: A category name from list_categories ("Wellness i spa", "Toplice").

children.description: Stays: an option for at least this many children with the adults.

date_from.description: YYYY-MM-DD: the first day the customer wants to use the voucher (stays: arrival).

date_to.description: YYYY-MM-DD: the last day (stays: departure). The voucher's validity and the option's periods must fit.

extra_discount_only.description: Only deals with an EXTRA discount active now (newsletter, card or site-wide voucher).

near.description: With a town in place: deals around it too (up to 40 km).

nights_max.description: Stays: at most this many nights.

nights_min.description: Stays: at least this many nights.

offset.description: Skip this many (paging: next_offset of the previous call).

pet_friendly.description: Only deals known to accept pets.

place.description: A town, island, region or country: "Opatija", "Krk", "Istra", "Dalmacija", "Zagorje", "Slovenija", "Hrvatska", or "Inozemstvo" for any country abroad.

price_max.description: EUR: an option (one voucher) costs at most this.

price_min.description: EUR: an option costs at least this.

query.description: Croatian words for the service, venue or theme ("wellness", "hotel s bazenom", "masaža lica", "Hotel Eden"). Leave places, prices, nights, persons and dates to their own fields.

seaside.description: Only deals on the Croatian coast (Istra, Kvarner, Dalmacija).

sort.description: best (default; the site's order, or the best match with query), price_asc, price_desc, discount_desc, newest.

venue.description: A hotel, restaurant, salon or partner by name ("Hotel Eden", "Terme Tuhelj").

name: search_deals
title: Search deals
